statement.essentials: The cartilage of the ear canal also points toward the nerve, but it moves and is a less exact guide.
statement.anatomy: The tragal pointer is often taught as 1 cm inferior and 1 cm deep to the trunk; measured distances disagree. The pointer is cartilaginous, mobile and has an irregular tip, and in one prospective series of 79 parotidectomies the distance was significantly less than 1 cm.

disagreement: Rea (6.9 mm) and Pather (34 mm) differ five-fold; Cannon 2004 found the distance smaller than the textbook 1 cm. The '1 cm' rule is a rule of thumb.
